commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text:
He goes on, to her friend.

My body and soul can’t bear this pain and mean to ride the palmyra horse that protects against it, having put aside the shame that would forbid it. Wisdom, self-control and the rest went first. Shame stayed, and now it has gone too. He says they will ride so that she sees how much he suffers and quickly grants what he asks.
